format.tails: All tails resolve inside [0,5760000); no looped10-second audition, silent placeholder, or exported tail extension.

roles.meaning: Abstract full-film harmony/melody role; timbre, notes and arrangement unapproved.

remove_control.expected_difference: Remove audible harmony/melodic narrative; prove by isolated and full-mix listening.

roles.meaning: Abstract rhythmic propulsion with intentional rests; no fixed tempo/instrument chosen.

remove_control.expected_difference: Remove audible rhythmic propulsion in its selected active passage.

roles.meaning: Original tactile action feedback at actual contact cues; a contact is not a separate track.

remove_control.expected_difference: Cut/imprint/trim/eye material contact feedback is audibly lost.

roles.meaning: Distinct short character/return gesture role, not a duplicate of T17.

remove_control.expected_difference: Hero lift loses its independently audible character gesture.

density_requests.intent: Sparse curiosity and four actual contacts; leave recognition readable
Materials gain motion with three distinct assembly cues
Anticipation, one flight arc, landing and reel release
At most three clearly differentiated tactile interactions
Deliberate reduced density or near silence
Build from pull to one world-release maximum, then reduce density
Thin enough for source reading; brief ordered withdrawal/restoration cues
One return gesture and in-window decay; no new climax

waveform_contract.source: Exact final delivered postmix PCM that will be heard, identified by SHA256, sample rate, channel count and sample count. Do not use the audition or only a detached stem.
waveform_contract.bin_mapping: Bin j in0..479 represents global project frame1680+j, samples[(1680+j)*1600,(1681+j)*1600). Store channel-aware min/max or documented stereo min/max union.
waveform_contract.amplitude_rule: Fixed documented mapping for the whole excerpt, no per-bin autoscaling. Low-density passage must retain its real amplitude.
waveform_contract.reveal: At g1710 begin revealing the paper-local waveform through a moving clip/alpha edge; cue ticks use actual global sample/frame position.
waveform_contract.dependency: Declare audio/waveform-S5.json in T13 cache_dependencies and record source PCM hash inside it. Changed mix requires envelope regeneration.
waveform_contract.blocked_behavior: Missing/unapproved PCM: visual design may show blank physical paper in review, but full production build must fail its completeness gate; T13 is not counted as verified.

verification_required: All four stems have distinct audible content and full120-second sample window
Independent actual listening to solo and removal-control mixes
Check exact contact onset/visual cue relation in rendered output
Run final mix/encode loudness and true-peak checks through existing pipeline; do not change its standard
